description: App-only adapter for the service form in the selected salonId. action=create prepares input.service; action=update prepares input.serviceId and input.patch. Saves a plan without changing the catalog. In conversation, use beautyos_service_create_prepare or beautyos_service_update_prepare with their specific schemas. The form requests explicit confirmation of the effects before beautyos_apply_change.
name: beautyos_prepare_service_change
title: UI: service change preview
